cards.answer: Xerath is a long-range mage who deals magic damage with AP-scaling spells. He pressures enemies with ranged spells, slows and a stun, then channels stationary long-range barrages.
cards.counterplay: Keep moving to evade his spells, use minions to screen his stun, and look for an opening while he channels his ultimate.

cards.answer: Mana Surge periodically lets Xerath restore mana with a basic attack, restoring more against champions. Killing enemies reduces its cooldown.
cards.counterplay: Pressure him when he approaches to attack, and avoid offering free attacks for mana.

cards.answer: Arcanopulse charges to extend its range while slowing Xerath, then fires a line of magic damage through enemies hit.
cards.counterplay: Move sideways as he charges; avoid lining up behind allies or minions.

cards.counterplay: Move away from the targeted area, especially its center.

cards.answer: Shocking Orb deals magic damage to the first enemy hit and stuns them. The stun lasts longer the farther the orb travels.
cards.counterplay: Use minions to screen the orb and sidestep it; look to approach after he uses it.

cards.answer: Rite of the Arcane immobilizes Xerath while he channels repeated long-range barrages. Each barrage strikes a targeted area after a delay and deals magic damage; hitting champions increases the damage of later barrages.
cards.counterplay: Keep changing direction between barrages, or pressure Xerath while he is stationary if you can reach him safely.
